column2: Target rung: named, specific to this project [SO2]
column6: Names the target rung on the outcome ladder in the team's own words and says what it means for this project; where other teams work on the project, states the split of work agreed with the partner.
column9: A target rung is named, but only in the ladder's words with nothing about this project, more than one rung is named or the rung is conditional, or, where other teams work on the project, the split is missing or not agreed with the partner.
column12: No explicit target rung, or the stated target does not correspond to the ladder.

column2: Metrics: measurable, with an instrumentation plan [SO2]
column6: 2 or 3 measurable signals of "it worked" (e.g., users completing a task, benchmark result, uptime, merged PRs), and for at least one, the tool or mechanism that will collect it and when it starts collecting, before the final release.
column9: Metrics are listed but some are not measurable as stated, or no metric says what will collect it and when.
column12: No success metrics, or none measurable as stated.

column2: Prerequisites and lead times: listed, owned, dated [SO1]
column6: Everything the target rung requires that the team does not control (accounts, reviews, approvals, recruitment) is listed, including every lead time the Shipping guide names for the path closest to this project, each with an owner and a start-by date that falls before the term it is needed.
column9: Prerequisites are listed, but one lead time the Shipping guide names for the path closest to this project is missing, or an item has no owner, no start-by date, or a start-by date in or after the term it is needed.
column12: No prerequisites listed, or two or more of the lead times the Shipping guide names for the path closest to this project are missing.

column6: Evidence that the partner has seen and agreed to this definition (meeting note, email, or survey confirmation) is included and verifiable.
column9: Partner agreement is claimed but the evidence is indirect or informal.

column6: 1 to 2 pages; every metric, prerequisite, and commitment to the partner is its own list item or table row.
column9: One of the two missing: outside 1 to 2 pages, or a metric, prerequisite, or commitment written into a paragraph.
